content_html:
Can you imagine living the National Holidays in Peru surrounded by music, dance, unique flavors and historical landscapes? Although the national celebration has passed this year, now is the ideal time to plan your trip for the upcoming National Holidays in 2026 and beyond.

What are the National Holidays of Peru?

Every July 28 and 29, Peru commemorates its independence with one of the most important celebrations in the country. The National Holidays are an explosion of culture, history and national pride. From military parades in Lima to traditional festivities in Cusco and other Andean regions, travel to Peru in July It is living the Peruvian identity at its maximum expression.

Why travel to Peru during National Holidays?

Traveling to Peru in July is a unique experience for many reasons:

  • Ideal climate to explore the mountains and the jungle.
  • Special events throughout the country: Fairs, concerts, typical dances and gastronomy.
  • Direct participation in authentic cultural celebrations.
  • Perfect season to visit iconic places like Cusco, Machu Picchu, the Sacred Valley or fist.

Live the National Holidays with GT Peru Travel

In GT Peru Travel we offer personalized experiences so you can celebrate the National Holidays like a local. Our programs combine cultural tourism, Peruvian gastronomy, contact with local communities and visits to the main attractions of the country.

We are already designing special packages for July 2026 and future years, with group and private outings to:

  • Cusco and Machu Picchu, with Andean celebrations.
  • Lima, with patriotic city tour and Creole gastronomy.
  • Arequipa, Puno and Lake Titicaca, with traditional festivals.
  • Peruvian Amazon, for different and enriching experiences.

Plan today, experience the excitement tomorrow

Although the National Holidays of 2025 have already passed, this is the perfect opportunity to anticipate and ensure a memorable trip for 2026. Book in advance and access better prices, exclusive accommodations and personalized attention.

Ready to discover Peru at its most festive?

At GT Peru Travel We help you experience Peru from within: Living culture, landscapes that inspire and experiences that mark.
